Measure the disk space of the model cache

Source: R/cache.R
cache_size.Rd

cache_size() measures the disk space of the model cache: it sums the sizes of all regular files beneath a cache root, including downloaded models and the files of custom models. A pinned model takes from about 31 MB to 1.3 GB of disk (the size_mb column of models()), and the cache keeps every model and custom model downloaded until it is removed, so this total is the basis for deciding what to remove.

It returns the total size in bytes. To list the files of one model, use model_status(); to delete one, use model_remove().

Usage

cache_size(cache_dir = default_cache_dir())

Arguments

cache_dir

Cache root (default the package cache directory, cache_dir()).

Value

A number: the total size in bytes, or 0 when the directory does not exist or is empty.

See also

cache_dir() for the location; model_status() for one model's files; model_remove() to free space.

Examples

cache_size(tempdir())
#> [1] 3503241
cache_size(file.path(tempdir(), "no-such-cache"))
#> [1] 0
